resources.string:
1. Open Telegram and search for @BotFather
2. Send /newbot and follow the instructions
3. Copy the token it gives you
4. Send a message to your bot
5. Visit: api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates
6. Copy the chat_id from the result
Check your Telegram chat. You should have received a test message.
SMS messages are being forwarded to Telegram
You need to configure your Telegram Bot Token and Chat ID before starting the service.
1. Make sure you have SMS and notification permissions\n2. Turn on the service with the button above\n3. SMS messages will be automatically forwarded to Telegram
Tap to see more configuration options
The app may be closed by the system. Tap here to configure the necessary permissions.
For the app to work correctly in the background, you need to disable battery optimization and enable autostart.

1. Go to Settings → Apps → Manage apps
2. Search for "Message Forwarder"
3. Turn on "Autostart"
4. In "Battery saver" select "No restrictions"

1. Go to Settings → App management
2. Search for "Message Forwarder"
3. Turn on "Allow autostart"
4. Turn off "Battery optimization"
1. Go to Settings → Battery → High background activity\n2. Turn on \"Message Forwarder\"\n3. In Permission manager, turn on \"Autostart\"

1. Go to Settings → Apps → Apps
2. Search for "Message Forwarder" → Battery
3. Turn off "Automatic management"
4. Turn on every option manually

1. Go to Settings → Device care → Battery
2. Tap "Background usage limits"
3. Add "Message Forwarder" to "Never sleeping apps"
4. Turn off "Put unused apps to sleep"
1. Go to Settings → Battery → Battery optimization\n2. Search for \"Message Forwarder\"\n3. Select \"Don\'t optimize\"
1. Go to Settings → Power Management\n2. Tap \"Auto-start Manager\"\n3. Turn on \"Message Forwarder\"

1. Go to Settings → Apps → Message Forwarder
2. Tap "Battery" or "Battery usage"
3. Select "No restrictions" or "Don't optimize"
4. If there's an "Autostart" option, turn it on
